provenance: Coarse public per-Mtok rate estimates for budgeting/estimation only, hand-entered from published vendor pricing pages as of 2026-07-25. NOT exact, NOT contractual, NOT a substitute for metered/exact usage from usage.py. Refresh periodically; treat as order-of-magnitude guidance for estimate.py and pre-dispatch budget gates only. The 'unknown' family is a zero-rated FALLBACK for addresses that resolved to no known pricing family (distinct from 'opencode-free-tier', which is a genuinely free tier) — its 0/0 rates mean 'no cost data', not 'no cost'; callers should treat any unknown-family estimate as untrustworthy and surface it to the operator rather than budget against it silently.
